result.summary: The page is generally well composed, but the fixed bottom navigation appears to overlap and obscure scrollable restaurant content near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The second card in the “Popular right now” section is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar. Its image/content continues underneath the navigation area, making the card’s lower portion inaccessible or visually hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scrollable feed so the final visible content clears the fixed bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels end with partially visible pills/cards at the right edge, including an unlabeled partial category pill. While this may indicate horizontal scrolling, it reads somewhat clipped and incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer carousel affordance, such as a fade gradient, peek treatment with consistent spacing, or an explicit horizontal-scroll indicator, and ensure partially shown category items remain recognizable.
